name: OpenShorts.io MCP
summary: Hosted MCP server that clips long videos into captioned shorts and reports job status and usage.
description: The hosted service turns a submitted long video into captioned short clips and provides job status and usage information. It is independently operated by the OpenShorts.io team. Its self-hosted pipeline is based on the MIT-licensed upstream OpenShorts project, while the hosted service has separate terms.

agent_access.notes: The initialize handshake is anonymous; account tool calls require a personal API key.
